name: sso-sign-in
title: SSO sign-in
description: Work-email sign-in for companies with single sign-on: the domain finds the identity provider and the button names exactly where you are going.
docs: resolveDomain(domain, { signal }) is yours: resolve to { organisation, providers } when single sign-on is set up, to null when it is not, and reject when the lookup itself failed. It runs once the address has a whole domain (acme.io, never acme.i) and the typing has paused for debounceMs (default 450); the answer for a domain the person has already left is thrown out and its signal aborts the request, and a domain is never looked up twice. The field is never disabled, so a slow lookup cannot block typing: a spinner sits inside it, and a status region says politely that a lookup is running and what it found. One provider gives a button that names the company (Continue with Acme SSO) under the company's name; several give tiles to choose from with nothing preselected (each provider can carry its own icon), and the button waits until one is chosen; a long company name wraps on the button instead of stretching the card; no providers gives a notice (No single sign-on is set up for acme.io) with an optional helpHref and the password route (onUsePassword), which is also a quiet button in the other states. onContinue({ domain, providerId }) sends the person on, and its busy state keeps the button in place and in focus, also when the call fails. Enter submits, and pressing Continue before the lookup has run makes it run at once. defaultEmail is looked up as soon as the card appears; footer, titleAs and labels as in the other cards.
